chunks: So those who were 'Ad turned insolent unjustly in the land, and said: "Who is stronger than us?" Did they not see that God who created them was greater far in power than they? Yet they refused to believe Our signs.

key_terms.اسْتَکْبَرُوا: They became arrogant or turned insolent
key_terms.عَادٌ: The tribe of 'Ad, an ancient Arab people known for their strength
key_terms.يَجْحَدُونَ: They deny or refuse to believe

ai.seo_question: What was the nature of the 'Ad tribe's arrogance and denial of God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse illustrates how the tribe of 'Ad’s material arrogance led to a spiritual blindness, causing them to reject the clear signs (Ayat) of their Creator despite His evident power. Their claim of superior strength was not merely physical but a theological denial of divine authority, a pattern often cited by scholars to warn against worldly pride that obscures recognition of God’s dominion.
